notes: Research pilot for three golf communities. Every fact has a source and a status: 'official' (club, HOA or public operator), 'reported' (news or directory), 'listing' (real estate marketing, confirm before relying on it) or 'missing'. Coordinates marked 'single source' are not yet confirmed by a second source.

communities.name: Copper Mill
communities.summary: A master-planned golf community in Zachary with its own 18-hole course, now owned by the homeowners association. Homes range from interior streets to golf-course frontage.

course.name: Copper Mill Golf Club
course.coordinateNote: Single source (Where2Golf). Confirm before relying on it.

clubAccess.summary: Copper Mill’s club offers a dedicated HOA membership for residents, separate from the memberships it sells to the public. Ask the HOA what your dues cover before you count golf as included.

resident.text: The club lists a Copper Mill HOA Membership: unlimited cart plans and membership for one year.
HOA members get unlimited golf, unlimited short-range access, preferred tee times, 10% off merchandise, a monthly charge account, discounted guest fees and a GHIN handicap.
Caleb’s Turnberry listing says the championship golf course, pool and tennis courts are all included in the HOA membership.
The Copper Mill Home Owners Association bought the golf course from the developer for $1.2 million.

public.text: The club sells a Platinum annual membership to non-residents, with unlimited golf and cart, preferred tee times and a GHIN handicap.
Posted Platinum prices disagree between club pages, so they are left out until the club confirms them.
public.detail: The tee-times page lists $199 a month or $2,250 a year (individual) and $299 a month or $3,250 a year (family). An earlier read of the membership page showed $399 a month or $4,550 a year (family), which could not be found again. Neither page is dated. Call the golf shop at (225) 658-0656.

public.text: Draft club rules (2023) reserve weekend tee times from 8 to 9 a.m. for members and let members book up to 180 days ahead.

communities.name: Santa Maria
communities.summary: A planned neighborhood of about 400 acres wrapped around a public Robert Trent Jones Sr. course, about a mile from I-10 off Highland Road.

course.name: Santa Maria Golf Course (BREC)
course.address: 18460 Santa Maria Pkwy, Baton Rouge, LA
course.detail: Robert Trent Jones Sr. design, opened 1987. Par 72 with about 15 lakes.
course.coordinateNote: From the existing course research on this site.

clubAccess.summary: The course is public and run by BREC. Living here does not come with golf privileges, and anyone can book a tee time.

points.text: Owned and operated by BREC, the Baton Rouge recreation and park commission, and open to the public.

public.text: Owned and operated by BREC, the Baton Rouge recreation and park commission, and open to the public.

hoa.duesNote: The property owners association publishes covenants and bylaws, but current dues were not found.

points.text: Comprehensive restrictions govern the neighborhood’s appearance. Covenants, bylaws and board information are on the association site.

golfFrontage.text: Listings on Garden Lake Ct and Southern Hills Ave describe homes along the 14th fairway and overlooking the 6th and 12th holes.

gated.text: Only one real estate site mentions gated security.

communities.name: Pelican Point
communities.summary: A large gated golf community in Gonzales with 27 holes of semi-private golf, a pool and tennis, and a 55+ neighborhood alongside single-family homes and townhomes.

course.name: Pelican Point Golf Club
course.detail: 27 holes across The Links (opened 1998) and The Lakes (opened 2002). One directory lists an 18-hole Links and a 9-hole Lakes.
course.coordinateNote: Single source (Where2Golf). Confirm before relying on it.

sources.label: Pelican Point Golf Club, official course page

clubAccess.summary: The club calls itself semi-private, serving members and guests. Golf is run separately from the HOA, so ask the club about resident and non-resident terms.

points.text: Pelican Point Golf Club describes itself as a semi-private club providing members and guests with 27 holes of golf.

public.text: Pelican Point Golf Club describes itself as a semi-private club providing members and guests with 27 holes of golf.

hoa.dues: About $465 to $900 a year, depending on the neighborhood

points.text: New owners register at the HOA office for vehicle decals and gate cards, and review the restrictions. Office: 40023 Pelican Point Pkwy, Suite A.
The HOA publishes community documents and a subdivision map for new residents.
